item.title: RDKit Molecular Similarity Search
item.description: Rank molecules in your supplied collection using Morgan radius 2, 2048 bits, chirality enabled and Tanimoto similarity. Query/hit drawings, exact scores and downloadable rankings; CPU only.

intended_use.statement: Structural ranking against exactly the supplied collection, <=10000 rows; not a search of all chemistry.

scope: Exact public package present in accessible Hub search; other matches omitted
